تستحضري (form X)
# تَسْتَحْضِرِي (tastaḥḍirī) /tas.taħ.dˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# تُسْتَحْضَرِي (tustaḥḍarī) /tus.taħ.dˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
